response.overview: This mind-bending two-part special event delivers a brilliant, futuristic satire targeting extreme atheism, science worship, and corporate video game hype. When Cartman becomes too impatient to wait three weeks for the release of the Nintendo Wii, he travels to a snowy mountain to freeze himself until the release date. However, a massive avalanche traps him, causing him to wake up over five hundred years in the future. In the year 2546, Cartman discovers a hyper-technological world where religion has been entirely eradicated—yet humanity is still locked in a brutal, ideological world war fought by rival, fanatical atheist factions over the correct name for their devotion to logic and reason.
response.tagline: The future is bright. The future is... completely ridiculous.
response.title: South Park: Go God Go
